title: HBURST, HSIZE, and Address Progression
description: Open a burst family or HSIZE to connect all legal base encodings, configured data width, accepted-beat count, address progression, wrapping, alignment, and the 1 KB rule that applies to every AHB burst.

signals.name: HSIZE
signals.description: HSIZE selects 2^HSIZE bytes in every beat and therefore the increment between sequential addresses.
signals.sampled: With every accepted address phase; stable for a burst
signals.typicalUse: For HSIZE=010, sequential word addresses increase by four bytes.
signals.verificationNote: HADDR must be aligned to 2^HSIZE, and the encoded transfer size must not exceed the configured data-bus width.

signals.name: SINGLE
signals.description: A standalone transfer with one NONSEQ address phase and no continuing SEQ beats.
signals.sampled: With the single accepted address phase
signals.typicalUse: Register access or isolated memory operation
signals.verificationNote: A SEQ transfer must not follow as part of the same SINGLE burst.

signals.name: INCR
signals.description: Starts with NONSEQ and continues with accepted SEQ beats, incrementing HADDR by 2^HSIZE. Undefined length does not waive the 1 KB boundary.
values: End and restart with NONSEQ before 1 KB
signals.typicalUse: Streaming transfers where length is controlled elsewhere
signals.verificationNote: Check accepted-beat progression and the 1 KB boundary separately from any implementation-specific arbitration service contract.

signals.name: INCR4/8/16
signals.description: Transfer exactly 4, 8, or 16 beats with each address increasing by the HSIZE byte count.
signals.sampled: Stable from first NONSEQ through final SEQ beat
signals.verificationNote: Count accepted beats, not elapsed cycles; wait states do not consume beats.

signals.name: WRAP4/8/16
signals.description: Increment addresses within a span equal to beats × bytes-per-beat, then wrap by modulo arithmetic. The starting address is size-aligned but need not equal the wrap base.
signals.sampled: Stable from first NONSEQ through final accepted SEQ beat
signals.typicalUse: Cache-line fills beginning at the requested critical word
signals.verificationNote: Compute the wrap boundary from both HBURST and HSIZE, count accepted beats only, and prove the entire burst remains within one 1 KB region.

signals.name: 1 KB boundary
signals.expansion: Every AHB burst stays inside one 1 KB decode region
signals.description: SINGLE, fixed INCR, undefined INCR, and WRAP bursts must not cross a 1 KB address boundary.
signals.sampled: Checked over every accepted beat in the burst
values: Undefined INCR ends and restarts before crossing
signals.verificationNote: Reject boundary-crossing stimulus in legal mode and inject it only in an explicit negative-test mode.
